name: Supplies to Auberdine
summary: Feero Ironhand carries provisions and messages from Maestra's Post to Auberdine, and the road north needs guards. Trouble near the Tower of Althalaxx and hostile infiltrators make the journey unsafe.

sections.title: A Perilous Road North
sections.body: Maestra's Post stands on Ashenvale's western frontier, between the forest and Darkshore. After investigations into sinister activity near the Tower of Althalaxx, Delgren the Purifier sends supplies and intelligence to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine. The outpost trusts armed escorts over lone couriers, so Feero Ironhand travels the forest road with guards.

sections.title: Shadows Along the Trail
sections.body: Feero Ironhand's journey north takes him through woods where ambushes threaten his delivery. Cultists of the Dark Strand want to silence reports of their demonic rituals. Forsaken scouts stalk the underbrush, and Balizar the Umbrage, Aligar the Tormentor, and Caedakar the Vicious each try to cut down the caravan before it reaches the border.

faq.answer: Feero Ironhand is a human courier at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. Delgren the Purifier trusts him with messages and supplies for Auberdine, and Feero will not travel without capable bodyguards.

faq.q: Why does Auberdine need these supplies?
faq.answer: Darkshore and northern Ashenvale face growing corruption and threats from demonic cultists near the Tower of Althalaxx. The night elf Sentinels in Auberdine, led locally by Sentinel Starbreeze, need provisions and current intelligence to defend the coast.

faq.q: Who attacks Feero along the road?
faq.answer: Feero warns that dangerous foes roam the forest and asks for guards. Their identities become clear during the escort.

faq.q: What is the connection to the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier directs efforts to uncover and disrupt the cultists' dark rituals at the Tower of Althalaxx. This escort grows from that investigation, carrying intelligence and support to the Night Elf leadership in Auberdine.

faq.q: Where do I report after protecting Feero?
aliases: where do i go after escorting feero
faq.answer: After you guide Feero safely through the Ashenvale ambushes, report to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post and confirm the delivery succeeded.

angles.text: By guarding this route, you help keep Ashenvale's outposts connected to Auberdine and preserve the Alliance's fragile hold on northern Kalimdor.
The supplies and messages you escort north aid the Sentinels in Auberdine as they face growing darkness across Darkshore and along the Ashenvale border.
As a human, you see Feero Ironhand show your people's willingness to support kaldorei allies in unfamiliar, dangerous ancient forests.
